title: On this day in space! Oct. 31, 2015: Creepy skull-shaped Halloween asteroid flies by Earth, NASA names it the 'Great Pumpkin'
caption:
In 2015, a space rock looking like a skeletal face zipped past our planet. Known as the Great Pumpkin, this 2,000-foot asteroid was mapped using radar to reveal its haunting features.

Source: Space - On this day in space! Oct. 31, 2015: Creepy skull-shaped Halloween asteroid flies by Earth, NASA names it the 'Great Pumpkin'
